scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
